description: Key facts a correct lesson on each Manufacturing Processes topic must state. Every fact was taken from the fetched text of the source page named with it (the quote is checked by `npm run golden:check`). Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions matched against the lesson text after LaTeX backslashes and braces are removed.
subject: manufacturing-processes

facts.claim: Raw materials are transformed into finished products

source.quote: the steps through which raw materials are transformed into a final product

facts.claim: Sand casting uses a sand mould

source.quote: a metal casting process characterized by using sand—known as casting sand—as the mold material

facts.claim: Sand moulds are cheap and refractory

source.quote: Molds made of sand are relatively cheap, and sufficiently refractory even for steel foundry use

facts.claim: Die casting forces molten metal into a mould under high pressure

source.quote: Die casting is a metal casting process that is characterized by forcing molten metal under high pressure into a mold cavity

facts.claim: Mostly non-ferrous metals (zinc, aluminium, magnesium)

source.quote: Most die castings are made from non-ferrous metals

facts.claim: Forging shapes metal with localised compressive forces

source.quote: Forging is a manufacturing process involving the shaping of metal using localized compressive forces

facts.claim: Cold, warm or hot forging

source.quote: cold forging (a type of cold working), warm forging, or hot forging

facts.claim: Larger gauge number means thinner sheet

source.quote: The larger the gauge number, the thinner the metal

facts.claim: Injection moulding forces molten material into a mould

source.quote: a manufacturing process for producing parts by injecting molten material into a mould

facts.claim: Turning: a stationary tool cuts a rotating workpiece (on a lathe)

source.quote: Turning is a machining process in which a cutting tool is held nearly stationary to cut a rotating workpiece

facts.claim: Machining is subtractive: controlled removal of material

source.quote: Machining is a form of subtractive manufacturing

facts.claim: Tool wear: gradual failure of cutting tools in use

source.quote: tool wear is the gradual failure of cutting tools due to regular operation

facts.claim: Wear is worst where tool temperature is highest

source.quote: this typically occurs where the tool temperature is highest

facts.claim: EDM removes material with sparks between electrodes in a dielectric

source.quote: a desired shape is obtained by using electrical discharges (sparks)

facts.claim: The electrodes are separated by a dielectric liquid

source.quote: separated by a dielectric liquid and subject to an electric voltage

facts.claim: Builds parts layer by layer from a 3D model

source.quote: the process of building parts from 3D model data and addi

facts.claim: From a CAD / digital 3D model

source.quote: the construction of a three-dimensional object from a CAD model or a digital 3D model

facts.claim: An electric arc between electrode and base metal melts the metals

source.quote: uses a welding power supply to create an electric arc between a metal stick ("electrode") and the base material

facts.claim: Supplies may be AC or DC; electrodes consumable or not

source.quote: consumable or non-consumable electrodes are used

facts.claim: Brazing melts only a filler, not the base metals

source.quote: Brazing differs from welding in that it does not involve melting the work pieces

facts.claim: Filler flows into the joint by capillary action

source.quote: the filler metal flows into the gap between close-fitting parts by capillary action
